To learn more about LABs including upcoming meetings visit: sonomalibrary.org/governance/lab Public comment may be submitted in writing prior to the meeting or orally during the meeting. Electronic Writing - Written comments may be submitted via email to to the Branch Manager. U.S. Mail - Written comments may be submitted via U.S. mail to the branch's mailing address. It is advised you consider normal delays in mail delivery when sending your written comment via U.S. mail. Orally, Live - Oral comments may be given during the meeting.

item.title: Summer Harvest Cooking: Learn and Lunch with Stephanie Klassen — Fri Jul 31, 10:30 AM — Gold Ridge Organic Farms
item.description:
Celebrate the flavors of the Mediterranean with this relaxed summer lunch menu. Learn how to make the most of your backyard or farmer's market bounty with this demonstration class taught by local cookbook author Stephanie Klassen.
She'll show you how to turn those overflowing baskets of summer veggies into a cool Summer Garden Gazpacho, a colorful Provencal Vegetable Galette and Green Bean-Feta Salad. (And don't forget Nonna's Olive Oil Cookies for dessert!) After the demo, we'll sit down together for an al fresco lunch overlooking our beautiful organic orchards.
What to Expect:
\*A hands-on cooking demonstration in our charming Apple Cottage kitchen
\*Expert tips from Stephanie on creating delicious dishes using fresh, local produce
\*A sit-down lunch featuring the dishes you just watched being made, enjoyed at a table overlooking our apple orchard
\*A signature refreshment: citrus shrub, freshly pressed apple cider or apple cider spritz\*

item.description: Don’t just tour the farm — explore it alongside the very farmer who built it, Brooke Hazen, in this immersive, behind-the-scenes experience. Step into the heart of Gold Ridge Organic Farms for an orchard hike led by our founder and farmer, Brooke Hazen. With over two decades of dedication poured into these 88 acres of certified organic farmland, Brooke will guide you through the orchards and share the story of how he transformed this land into a thriving sanctuary for heirloom apples, olives, and citrus. item.title: The Outlet Gallery & Block Party 2026 — Sat Aug 1, 3:00 PM — Coal Shed Brewery
item.description:
The Outlet Gallery Art, Healing, and Community with First Responders Saturday, August 1 | 3-8 PM Mare Island Brewing Co. - Coal Shed Brewery | Vallejo, CA Free admission. Firefighters and first responders carry experiences most people never see. For many, art becomes the outlet. The Outlet is a free art show hosted by First Responders Outlet, a nonprofit founded by firefighters from the Richmond Fire Department. This event brings original artwork, live music, and community together along the Vallejo waterfront - and opens a window into the creative lives of the people who serve us. Original artwork created by first responders Food trucks Resource tents and vendors Interactive art experiences Dedicated kid zones Silent auction and raffles Live music Craft beer, wine, and cocktails Learn more about The Outlet on their website and Instagram. View this profile on Instagram The Outlet \(@ the\_outlet\_first\_responders\) - Instagram photos and videos

The evening will provide an opportunity for residents, fair supporters, exhibitors, volunteers, community partners, and the public to connect directly with Fair leadership, share ideas, ask questions, and discuss the future of the Solano County Fair.
The meeting will begin with introductory remarks from CEO Tom Keaney, followed by an open session and public comment. The focus of the evening will be on hearing directly from the community about what they value most, what they'd like to see in the years ahead, and how the Fair can continue to grow as a cherished tradition for Solano County.

item.title: Max Vogel + The Pickups — Fri Jul 31, 6:00 PM — Rio Nido Roadhouse
item.description:
Max Vogel is a country artist from Windsor, California, who has been singing and playing music his entire life. He picked up a guitar at 15 years old and hasn’t put it down since, spending years honing his craft as a singer, songwriter, and performer.
Inspired by artists like Garth Brooks, Alan Jackson, Randy Travis, Eric Church, Zac Brown Band, and Brooks & Dunn, Max blends traditional country roots with a modern edge. His music is built on honest storytelling, strong melodies, and the kind of songs that bring people together.
After many years performing as a solo artist, Max recently joined forces with a talented group of musicians to form Max Vogel & the Pickups. Together, they bring a high-energy country show filled with heartfelt originals, crowd-favorite country anthems, and a genuine connection with every audience they play for.

item.title: The Cemetery Club — Fri Jul 31, 8:00 PM — Bay Area Stage Theatre on Broadway
item.description:
Don’t be fooled by the title of this play – it’s a comedy!
Ivan Menchell’s The Cemetery Club is a bittersweet comedy about three Jewish widows in Queens, New York, who meet monthly to visit their husbands' graves. Their routine is upended when one of them begins dating a widower, who, they incidentally, meet at the cemetery. The ensuing drama tests their loyalties, offering a poignant look at love, friendship and moving on.
Source: North Bay Bohemian
